feed_title: Orthopaedic Bolster Dog Bed for Large Dogs, Egg Crate Foam, Waterproof Membrane, Large 91 x 69cm and XL 107 x 76cm, Grey | PawLunova Nocturne
descriptionHtml:
91 and 107cm. Egg-crate foam. An edge on one side only.

Nocturne is an orthopaedic bolster dog bed for large dogs, in Large 91 × 69 × 17cm and Extra Large 107 × 76 × 19cm, with a profiled egg-crate foam base. Grey or Dark Grey.

Owning a big dog teaches you that most beds called large were sized for a spaniel. Yours ends up front half on, back legs out on the lino. Buy one walled all round and they sleep with a shoulder jammed in a corner.

An open-sided bolster is the way out. The raised edge gives a chin something to press into. The open side lets them roll out.

What they get

  • Profiled foam underneath: Egg-crate foam cushions the whole sleeping surface.
  • An edge when they want it: A raised bolster for the chin, not a wall all round.
  • Protected from the inside: A waterproof membrane between the plush cover and the foam.
  • A cover you will actually remove: Plush, on a heavy-duty zip, off for washing.

Best for: Large dogs who lean and then stretch right out. Borrowdale and Kendal suit dogs wanting contact everywhere. This gives an edge and a runway.

Why it is worth the money

£125 for the Large, £145 for the Extra Large, and you are buying what a cheap bed leaves out. Profiled egg-crate foam rather than loose filling. A waterproof membrane between the plush and that foam. A heavy-duty zip that survives use. A base that does not skate. If a written 5-year foam guarantee is what you want, our Coniston and Helvellyn carry one.

And you have 100 nights to decide. If it is not their bed, we arrange the free UK mainland collection and refund the lot.

One warning about size, the expensive mistake here. The Large is 91.4 × 68.6cm outside, bolster included. A dog who sleeps flat out rather than curled belongs on the Extra Large, whatever the photo suggests.

Size and fit

SizeExact (cm)
Large91.4 × 68.6 × 16.5
Extra Large106.7 × 76.2 × 19.1

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The bolster sits inside these figures, so size up between sizes. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Open the heavy-duty zip, lift the cover away and wash it to its care label. Dry right through before refitting. Never soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. Any guarantee we give is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

Large or Extra Large?

Curled sleepers manage the Large. Flat-out sleepers want the XL.

How much is delivery?

Nothing over £40, which both sizes clear.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. The choices are visible at checkout.

Where does the waterproof layer sit?

Between the plush cover and the foam.

Is it right for a big dog slowing down?

Egg-crate foam throughout, 16.5cm on the Large, one raised edge. Nothing promised. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The heavy-duty zip means the cover comes off easily.

They have refused every bed so far.

It goes back inside 100 nights, refunded in full.

Choose Large or Extra Large and give them an edge and a runway.

facts_used: Nocturne is an orthopaedic bolster dog bed for large dogs, with a profiled egg-crate foam base, a waterproof inner membrane and a non-slip base. Large (91 × 69cm) and Extra Large (107 × 76cm), in Grey or Dark Grey.
Nocturne's bolster is open-sided, so they can prop a chin on the edge, then roll out to full length without ever leaving the bed.
**Profiled foam underneath:** Egg-crate foam cushions the whole sleeping surface.
**Protected from the inside:** A waterproof inner membrane sits between the plush cover and the foam, so a spill or a wet coat stays off the foam.
**A cover you will actually remove:** Plush, with a heavy-duty zip, and it comes off for washing.
**It stays where you put it:** The non-slip base helps keep the bed in place on smooth floors.
Large £125.00 (Dark Grey / Grey); Extra Large £145.00 (Dark Grey / Grey)
Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that, so between sizes, size up.
Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
differentiation_note: The big-dog bed that refuses the either/or: an open-sided bolster giving both an edge to lean on and open floor to stretch into, in the batch's only egg-crate-plus-plush build with a heavy-duty zip. Its fact sheet carries no 5-year foam guarantee, so the page states no per-night figure and instead points guarantee-led shoppers to Coniston and Helvellyn.
